notes: County site links to the elections office site jimwellscountyelections.gov (WordPress), whose 'All Notices' page lists every posted file; file names carry the Hart report run time. Its 'Election History' link (electionhistory.jimwellscountyelections.gov, an ElectionStats ballot verifier loaded by JavaScript) is a post-election archive. No Clarity link. 2024 general: night cumulative county totals 'Unoffical-on-ED-Cumulative-Results-11-5-2024-07-41-11-PM' and '2024-General-UNOFFICIAL-Cumulative-Results-11-5-2024-10-17-17-PM'; the first precinct file is '2024-GENERAL-ELECTION-UNOFFICIAL-Precinct-Results-11-6-2024-11-31-46-AM' (Last-Modified Wed, 06 Nov 2024 16:30:34 GMT; PDF CreationDate 17:32 UTC, so the two clocks differ by about an hour). 2026 primary: night file 'Unofficial-Cumulative-Results-3-3-2026-08-56-04-PM' (county totals, Last-Modified Wed, 04 Mar 2026 03:00:43 GMT = 9:00 PM CST), then 'Unofficial-after-EVBB-Cumulative-Results-3-9-2026' and the only precinct file 'FINAL-AFTER-CANVASS-6735-TOTAL-Precinct-Results-3-17-2026'. 2026 runoff: only 'UNOFFICIAL-Cumulative-Results-5-26-2026-08-22-37-PM' (county totals, Last-Modified Wed, 27 May 2026 01:25:43 GMT = 8:25 PM CDT); no runoff precinct file. Check 3 pending (wayback-data branch not on origin).
tag_rationale: All three elections are LATER (county totals on election night, precinct numbers the next day, at canvass, or never), so the tag is COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS; confidence med because the 2026 primary and runoff were settled by check 2 with printed run times and Last-Modified times on election night.
